If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, reduce the forecast by 2–5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is trending up, increase forecast by 1–3% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is mixed and forecast is flat, apply a 1–3% downward adjustment for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment spikes from negative to positive, shift forecast peak 2–4 days earlier and reduce magnitude by 5–10%.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, suppress forecast overshoots by 3–7% in late horizon.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is overcorrected upward, apply a 5–10% downward correction in mid horizon.
